zh.text: 模组管理：已安装卡片新增「卸载」按钮（在「详情」左侧），二次确认后把 mods/<目录> 移入系统回收站（可从回收站还原；回收站不可用时才直接删除），卸载前会先禁用该模组；模组市场卡片移除「源码」按钮，仓库地址改到「详情」里以可点击链接展示；市场卡片描述固定为两行（超出省略），空标签行也会保持高度，使并排卡片的标签区与元信息行横向对齐
修复「卸载」按钮的确认框反复弹出：卸载监听器被误写在「详情」按钮的循环里，导致每个详情按钮都给它注册一次（有 N 张卡就弹 N 次）；现在只注册一次，卸载成功/失败各只提示一条
启动器左上角版本号改为读取真实运行版本（app.getVersion()），此前顶部品牌行与「当前版本」是写死的旧版本号（一直显示 v0.1.18），现在会随版本更新
模组卡片图标按「创建模组」的分类区分：玩法 / 经济 / AI / 画面 / 工具 各有不同图标（此前全部显示盾牌），未分类时退回按类型显示
模组卡片的元信息改为图标版：「MOD大小」「本地版本」「更新时间」都带专属小图标，其中更新时间仅保留年月日（YYYY-MM-DD）；市场卡片同步使用图标：「下载次数」「更新于」「本地」均带图标，文字标签放到悬停提示里
模组标签改为 GitHub 标签样式的圆角胶囊（分类徽章、标签、需重启、已安装 / 可更新 / 可安装等），字号由 9–10px 放大到 11–11.5px；同时给 19 处只写了等宽字体的样式补上中文回退字体（微软雅黑 / PingFang / Noto Sans CJK），此前中文在这些位置会掉到系统默认字体、明显偏小
已安装页的「全部启用」「全部停用」和「显示 N / M」补上多语言：此前词典里根本没有这几个词条，切到英文仍然是中文
模组分类与标签补齐 7 种语言词条（经济 / 画面 / 锁定 / 集火 / 开火 / 自动 / 采矿 / 探索 / 工业 / 制造 / 市场 / 交易 … 共 44 条），卡片标签改为逐个词翻译；此前只有「玩法」「需重启」等少数词条有翻译，英文模式下会中英混排
模组页签「已安装 / 我创建的 / 模组市场」补上多语言：此前标签文字和计数拼在同一个文本节点里，词典永远匹配不到，切到英文也不变；现已把标签拆成独立节点

en.text: Mod management: installed cards gained an Uninstall button (left of Details) that asks for confirmation and moves mods/<folder> to the system Recycle Bin (restorable; falls back to a hard delete only when the bin is unavailable) after disabling the mod; market cards no longer carry a Source button — the repository URL now appears as a clickable link inside Details; the market card description is clamped to two lines and empty tag rows keep their height, so the tag and meta rows of cards side by side line up horizontally

Fixed the uninstall confirmation dialog popping up repeatedly: the uninstall listener was mistakenly registered inside the Details-button loop, so every Details button added another listener (N cards = N dialogs); it is now registered once and uninstall reports exactly one success or failure toast

The version shown in the launcher header now comes from the running build (app.getVersion()); the brand line and the update dialog's Current version were hard-coded to a stale value (v0.1.18) and now follow the actual release
Mod card icons now differentiate the Create-mod categories (Gameplay / Economy / AI / Visuals / Tools) instead of all showing a shield; uncategorised mods fall back to their kind icon

Mod cards now show their meta info with icons: Mod size, Local version and Updated each carry a dedicated small icon, and the Updated timestamp keeps the date only (YYYY-MM-DD); market cards match this treatment with icons for Downloads, Updated and Local, leaving the text label in the hover tooltip

Mod tags are now GitHub-style rounded pills (category badge, tags, restart-required, Installed / Update / Available) with the type size raised from 9–10px to 11–11.5px; 19 styles that only listed monospace fonts also gained CJK fallbacks (Microsoft YaHei / PingFang / Noto Sans CJK), so Chinese no longer drops to the system default font at a visibly smaller size
The installed page's Enable all / Disable all buttons and the Showing N / M counter are now localised: these entries were missing from the dictionary entirely, so they stayed Chinese in English mode

Mod categories and tags gained dictionary entries in all 7 languages (Economy / Graphics / Lock / Focus fire / Fire / Auto / Mining / Exploration / Industry / Manufacturing / Market / Trading … 44 entries) and card tags are now translated one by one; previously only a handful such as Gameplay and Restart required were translated, so English mode showed a mix of English and Chinese

The mod tabs Installed / Created by me / Mod market are now localised: the label and the counter shared a single text node, so the dictionary lookup could never match and switching to English left them unchanged; the label is now its own node
